task: ae.roaring: Roaring-style compressed bitmap, bit-sliced index and bitmap-index query engine
reasoning_summary: Designed three container encodings with canonical size rules, set algebra via word ops or merges, a CRC-sealed format with structural validation, an O'Neil bit-sliced index and a precedence-climbing query parser. Tests are differential (TreeSet, brute force, generated query ASTs) with invariant checks after each mutation. First run had 3 failures, all wrong hand-written expectations in tests; the second run passed.
